sum: Comstock Holding Companies, Inc., a real estate company, engages in the development, acquisition, operation, and management of mixed-use, transit-oriented properties, and data center developments. The company provides real estate services to its asset-owning clients, including asset management, property management, development and construction management, and others. It serves institutional real estate investors, high net worth family offices, financial institutions, and governmental bodies. The company was formerly known as Comstock Homebuilding Companies, Inc. and changed its name to Comstock Holding Companies, Inc. in June 2012. Comstock Holding Companies, Inc. was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Reston, Virginia.
